workstreams.name: Spain retail attractiveness
workstreams.answers: How large and attractive is the Spanish retail market for Quinta Azul's olive oil?
activities: Size Spanish retail demand and growth by segment
Map retail channels and regulation affecting olive oil
Rate segment attractiveness for Quinta Azul's oil

workstreams.name: Competitors and buyer needs
workstreams.answers: Who competes in Spanish retail olive oil, and what do retail buyers and shoppers there need?
activities: Profile competitors and their position in Spanish retail
Interview Spanish retail buyers on what they look for
Collect shopper views on how they choose olive oil

workstreams.name: Capability to win in Spain
workstreams.answers: Does Quinta Azul have the assets and capabilities to win in Spanish retail?
activities: Interview leaders and the people who do the work
Review operational data and documents on current assets
Assess gaps between assets and what winning in Spain takes

workstreams.name: Entry options for Spain
workstreams.answers: Which entry options exist for Quinta Azul in Spain, and how do they compare on agreed criteria?
activities: Identify entry options for selling in Spanish retail
Agree comparison criteria with Quinta Azul's leaders
Compare options on the agreed criteria

workstreams.name: Spain business case
workstreams.answers: Does the business case for the preferred entry option support a go or no-go on Spain?
activities: Build a business case for the preferred entry option
Model costs, revenue and risks of the option in Spain
Test the business case against the go or no-go question

workstreams.name: Spain entry roadmap
workstreams.answers: If the answer is go, what entry plan and roadmap should Quinta Azul follow in Spain?
activities: Sequence the steps to enter Spanish retail
Draft the entry plan and roadmap for approval
